dict.string: Trendzo uses the camera so you can photograph a garment in your store - for example, shooting the front and back of a shirt - and turn those photos into studio-quality product images and on-model mockups for your catalog listings.

Trendzo uses your location only while you are setting up your store address, to centre the map on where you are and fill in your street address and pincode automatically instead of typing them by hand. Trendzo never requests or uses your location in the background.

Trendzo saves images to your photo library only when you tap Save on a finished mockup - for example, downloading a generated product photo so you can share it with customers or use it in your own marketing.

Trendzo needs access to your photo library so you can choose existing photos to upload - for example, picking a garment photo you already shot, or attaching your GST certificate and bank proof during business verification.
